title: Splat Studio
tagline: Drag a cloud of glowing splats into view, then switch on local PCA and watch its fuzzy geometry settle into a surface.

paper.title: PCAsplat: Gaussian Splatting with Local PCA Regularization

novelty: A procedural, interactive visualization of Gaussian splats with an on/off local-shape regularization effect; no known implementation (not verified).
description: Orbit a glowing procedural scene made of Gaussian-like splats, then compare the irregular view with a PCA-inspired surface-aligned view.
howItWorks: An offline WebGL2 renderer draws procedural splats as instanced camera-facing quads. The regularization control interpolates their shape from varied blobs toward flattened surface-oriented marks, illustrating the local PCA geometric signal. This is a visual analogy on synthetic geometry, not PCAsplat training or a learned scene.
controls: Drag to orbit; wheel or pinch to zoom; use the REGULARIZE switch to compare the surface-aligned view; adjust Splat density from 5,000 to 40,000.
